purpose: UK/Ireland golf club release evaluation question bank for end-user answer accuracy and answer quality.

researchSources.title: BRS Core public site
researchSources.notes: BRS states it is trusted by 3,500+ clubs across 14 countries and used by 670,000+ club members in the UK and Ireland; named customer logos include The Abbey, The Belfry, Dumbarnie, Leven, Royal Belfast and South Ayrshire.

researchSources.title: BRS Tee Sheet product page
researchSources.notes: Tee sheet features include cloud access, reports, configurable intervals, member protection, course utilisation, multiple course configurations, central diary, marketing capture, GolfNow integration, facility management, services/buggies and no-show controls.

researchSources.title: BRS Member Booking product page
researchSources.notes: Member booking covers casual and competition tee times, app/mobile/desktop booking, club messages, three-minute tee time locking, waiting lists, tee time releases, buggy booking, handicap integrations and privilege/category controls.

researchSources.title: BRS Memberships product page
researchSources.notes: Memberships covers billing, online payments, flexible payment schemes, automated non-payer grace periods, custom filters, member bills, reminders and integration with the member portal/app.

researchSources.title: BRS Payments product page
researchSources.notes: Payments covers member bills, visitor green fees, catering and room hire, phone and email payment links, competition payments, VAT/invoice/refund/payout reporting, partial refunds and Stripe-backed processing.

researchSources.title: BRS Visitor Booking product page
researchSources.notes: Visitor Booking covers online visitor/open competition booking and pre-payment, website integration, dynamic pricing, golf packages, GDPR-compliant visitor data capture, GolfNow distribution, branded booking engines and protection of member times.

researchSources.title: BRS Competitions and Handicapping product page
researchSources.notes: Competitions links BRS with Golf Genius, WHS, HandicapMaster and Club Systems, with fixtures/results in the member app/site, contactless scoring, leaderboards and score entry.

researchSources.title: Stanedge Golf Club public site
researchSources.notes: Ten-hole Derbyshire club with BRS tee-time links, buggy hire, open competitions, coaching, membership options, societies, clubhouse/dining and 24/7 online reservations.

researchSources.title: Dumbarnie Links public site
researchSources.notes: High-volume destination links with visitor bookings, fees, resident rates, tour operators, group outings, caddie services, foul weather policies, FAQ, shop and international visitor logistics.

researchSources.title: The Belfry public golf page
researchSources.notes: Large resort with three courses, course-specific booking links, golf breaks, membership, coaching, corporate/group days, dining/spa, and strict tee-time arrival/no-refund policy.

researchSources.title: Enniscrone Golf Club public site
researchSources.notes: Irish championship links with book-a-tee-time, visitors, dining, course handicap calculator, members area and international visitor appeal.

researchSources.title: Longniddry Golf Club public site
researchSources.notes: Scottish member/visitor club with visitor info, online booking, member login, open events/results, green fees, society golf, pro shop, coaching, course status and catering updates.

researchSources.title: County Louth Golf Club public site
researchSources.notes: Irish championship links with BRS visitor booking, members area, green fees, visitor information, gift vouchers, dress code, caddies, pro shop, restaurant and weather/course info.

researchSources.title: Beccles Golf Club public site
researchSources.notes: Small Suffolk 9-hole club with BRS visitor booking, very low green fees, weekly competitions, members-only Saturday competition windows, WHS handicaps and light admin footprint.

researchSources.title: Golf Monthly feature on small UK/Ireland nine-hole clubs
researchSources.notes: Covers Beccles, Helmsdale, Lybster, Mulranny and Blacklion; themes include volunteer-run clubs, low green fees, small memberships, visitor day passes, cross-border currency handling and remote/community operations.

researchSources.title: Golf Monthly feature on rising UK/Ireland green fees
researchSources.notes: Highlights premium links/destination-club pricing, dynamic pricing complexity, visitor demand, regional price pressure and international visitor traffic.

researchSources.title: Golf Monthly feature on member guest rates
researchSources.notes: Shows member guest-rate sensitivity, guest categories, peak restrictions, member benefits and the need to distinguish visitor, member guest and membership prices.

researchSources.title: TalkSport summary of Royal Portrush visitor access
researchSources.notes: Shows high-end visitor restrictions by weekday, member competition day constraints, multi-course pricing, caddies, dress-code/member-of-a-club requirements and no-visitor windows.

researchSources.title: Local repo workflow-family audit
researchSources.notes: Current BRS top-level areas are Dashboard, Timesheet, Messages, Golf Plus, Facilities, Contacts, Memberships, Users, Reports, Search, Tools and Need Help; Memberships is embedded and coverage is partial in several workflows.

researchSources.title: Local repo answer-coverage audit
researchSources.notes: Flags static-heavy areas including golf events, contact setup and online booking; Memberships billing, subscriptions, members, accounts, settings and detailed reports remain priority evidence targets.

clubSample.archetype: small 9-hole / low green fee / BRS visitor booking

accuracy.description: Correct BRS workflow/product answer, no misleading navigation, does not invent club policy or live data.

completeness.description: Includes key steps, caveats, verification/check step, and safe distinction between similar workflows.

actionability.description: A real pro-shop/admin/member-support user can follow it without extra guesswork.

communicationQuality.description: Clear, concise, well-paragraphed, natural grammar, uses bullets/steps where helpful.

customerSuitability.description: Appropriate tone and confidence, handles ambiguity, avoids unsafe mutation promises and avoids overlong support noise.

passBands.label: excellent
passBands.meaning: Safe for customer release on this intent.

passBands.label: borderline
passBands.meaning: Could help but should be reviewed before broad release.

passBands.label: fail
passBands.meaning: Wrong, unsafe, hallucinated, or not useful.

criticalFailConditions: Claims it completed a live action when it only provided guidance.
Invents club-specific prices, cancellation policies, weather policies, availability or member rules.
Tells users to perform a payment/refund/message/permission/settings mutation without safety caveat or verification.
Confuses BRS admin workflows with public golfer/member self-service workflows in a way likely to mislead.
Gives a generic answer with no BRS-specific path for a BRS workflow question.
